findings.evidence: research R11, FR-025, FR-029: `health` validates with the base control-plane composition only (src/Iskender.Infrastructure.Container/ContainerEntryPoint.cs:72-74, 287-296), so a worker document with a `work` section fails the probe and exits 1 while `work` serves with it. FR-014, WCON Dispatch and apply rule 8: the apply unit opens with the 60 s UnitOfWorkOptions.Timeout default (WorkDispatcher.cs:459, 569; UnitOfWorkOptions.cs:36-41), so a handler timeout above 60 s ends in persistence.timeout. Gap type partial. T065.

FR-014, WCON Retry and poison rule 1: timeout and shutdown are chosen only for OperationCanceledException (WorkDispatcher.cs:501-505); a handler inside a unit statement gets persistence.cancelled and is recorded unclassified / core.internal. Gap type partial. T066.

FR-011, FR-018, TR-6, SC-002: PassAsync awaits each scope in turn (WorkDispatcher.cs:183), so dispatch.concurrency is unreachable beyond scopeConcurrency and a slow handler delays every other scope; ShardSpreadTests.cs:44 codifies it. Gap type partial. T067.

WCON Version skew rule 2, Diagnostics rule 1: skew counts are per directory page (WorkDispatcher.cs:166-186, 574-582), so 8008 appeared/cleared and the gauge flap when due scopes exceed batchSize. Gap type partial. T068.
WCON Diagnostics rule 2, FR-033: JobRunner.cs:91-94 drops a failed job check or lease acquire with no 8012. Gap type partial. T069.

FR-024, T032: NoAdvisoryLockInWorkTests.cs:10 forbids only pg_advisory, pg_try_advisory, and the nonexistent IAdvisoryLock, missing IUnitOfWork.AcquireAdvisoryLockAsync / AdvisoryLockName. Production code is compliant. Gap type partial. T070.

WCON Diagnostics rule 2: item-level failures call PassFailed (WorkDispatcher.cs:355) and PassSucceeded resets it (:126), so 8012 repeats every pass; a TryAcquireAsync failure (:245) leaves started shard tasks un-awaited (:263). Gap type partial. T071.
WCON Tracing rule 2: a lost-lease discard writes 8010 lease_lost but ends the span fencing_rejected (WorkDispatcher.cs:459-463, 520-527). Gap type contradicts. T072.
WCON Shutdown rule 1, T049: ShutdownTests.cs builds its start-up with no jobs (line 125), so no test shows a due job does not start after the signal. Gap type partial. T073.
T040, SC-005: SettleDirectoryRaceTests ProduceAsync returns null for a caught exception with no recorded unit failure, skipping the code assertion. Gap type partial. T074.
FR-002, WCON Work items rule 2: no test shows a payload of exactly 65,536 bytes is accepted (OutboxTests.cs:68 tests only +1). Gap type partial. T075.
T014, WCON The outbox rule 2: the enqueue check order (PostgreSqlWorkOutbox.cs:55-73) is untested; each case breaks one condition only. Gap type partial. T076.

LCON Modes rule 1, FR-038: docs/04-technology-stack-and-deployment.md:157 says the dependencies mode stops the planes, not naming the worker. Gap type partial. T078.

FR-014, FR-016, FR-017, spec Edge Cases (a handler hangs), WCON Dispatch and apply rule 8: ApplyAsync starts the handler-timeout timer (WorkDispatcher.cs:504) before OpenAsync/AcceptAsync (:509-511), which wait on the shard fence-row lock held by a shard-mate apply (PostgreSqlFencingGuard.cs:10-12) under the 30 s statementTimeout; ShardAsync starts several items of one shard at once (:353-365), so waiting items are charged work.handler_timeout or persistence.timeout without running and can be poisoned, and they hold the scope slots meanwhile. TimeoutAndRenewalTests.cs:61-63 avoids the case. Gap type contradicts. T079.

FR-027: WorkDispatcherStartup.cs:104 runs jobs on _stopClaiming.Token, linked into the run token at JobRunner.cs:148, so a job run in flight at the signal is cancelled at once and reported 8011 failed, instead of running until shutdownDelay + shutdownTimeout. Gap type contradicts. T080.

WCON Version skew rule 2, Diagnostics rule 1: _cursor resets at WorkDispatcher.cs:178, but ReportSkew and the _cycleSkewed reset (:214-218) run only after Task.WhenAll succeeds, so a scope failure on the last page carries stale skew counts into the next cycle. Gap type partial. T081.
T069, WCON Diagnostics rule 2: JobRunnerTests.cs:119-149 fails only the job check; the lease-acquire failure branch (JobRunner.cs:128) has no test. Gap type partial. T082.

SC-005, T040: RemovalRaceTests.cs:24-25, 102-116 settle through a copied remaining-work query instead of the production WorkDispatcher.SettleAsync (:601) and its RemainingSql (:56-57). Gap type partial. T083.

FR-018, spec Edge Cases (a handler hangs), WCON Known limits (Polling), T067: RunAsync (WorkDispatcher.cs:132) awaits PassAsync, which awaits every scope with Task.WhenAll (:205); scopes await their shard passes (:310) and a shard runs its batch serially (:346-354), so one hung or long handler stops all paging and claiming on the worker until its batch ends. Gap type contradicts. T084.

HCON Lifetimes (handlers and jobs are container singletons; rule 1 'None is transient'), FR-007: WorkRegistrations.cs:47 and :79 register handlers and jobs with AddTransient, resolved from the root provider per attempt (PostgreSqlServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:166, :190); WorkRegistrationsTests.cs:23-24 asserts Transient. Gap type contradicts. T085.

WCON Dispatch and apply rules 1 and 3, FR-010, TR-6: ScopeAsync always tries shards in ascending order (WorkDispatcher.cs:265) under a per-pass scope-slot semaphore (:260, :267), so with scopeConcurrency below shards a shard 0 backlog starves the scope's other shards without bound. Gap type partial. T086.

WCON Shutdown rule 2 and TR-13 ('the item stays pending') versus Retry and poison rule 4: WorkDispatcher.cs:442 poisons on attempt >= maximum for every class, so a shutdown cancellation on the last attempt poisons the item. Needs a maintainer decision. Gap type contradicts. T087.

WCON Shutdown rules 3 and 4, T049: JobRunner.cs:180 releases the job lease with CancellationToken.None, the startup passes the runner no abandon token (WorkDispatcherStartup.cs:104), and StopAsync waits for _jobs unbounded (:132). Gap type partial. T090.

PCON Isolation rule 10.3 ('producers never wait on each other for the row'), research R3: ScopeDirectory.cs:50-51, 87-90 lowers due_at with an UPDATE after the FOR KEY SHARE read (and LowerAsync :102-103), which takes a row lock, so two producers that both lower one scope's row serialize until the first commits; crossed idempotency keys across two such units can deadlock (40P01, transient). Code follows Register step 1; the contract summary overstates. Gap type contradicts.
